newsitem.title: INDIA: Sluggish demand for Indian castor, prices ease.
newsitem.headline: Sluggish demand for Indian castor, prices ease.

text.p: Indian castorseed December delivery prices eased to 1,087 rupees from 1,090 rupees on fresh speculative offerings and sluggish demand, traders said.
"Sluggish export demand kept the market down," one trader said. "However technically the market is a bit oversold and shortcovering may lift prices."

Groundnut oil fell further to 365/367 rupees per 10 kg from 372/373 rupees on new crop arrivals of about 140-150 tonnes coupled with sluggish physical buying. Delivery-after-a-week prices were quoted lower at 359/360 rupees per 10 kg.
In Rajkot spot oil slid by 10 to 540 rupees per 15 kg.
